provenance.author: claude (independent held-out corpus author)
provenance.source: Entirely synthetic, hand-authored in this task; no private or public issue data copied.
provenance.independence: No classifier prompts, classifier outputs, triage evaluation answers, or inference were consulted.
provenance.labelingBasis: Report communicative intent for category; repository facts and IssueRouting.Decide/ApparentFix for routes.
provenance.intendedUse: Same frozen reports and repository for baseline and advisory runs; labels are scoring-only and must never enter model context.
provenance.sampleDesign: 15 mechanism-coverage cases, 3 per category; not a statistical benchmark or estimate of production accuracy.

freezePolicy: Immutable after first evaluation output. Do not tune reports, labels, acceptable routes or repository against results. Any future corpus revision needs a new identity and independent labeling before outputs.

corpusIdentity.digestRecipe: UTF-8 concatenation, ordinal path order, of lowercase sha256 + two ASCII spaces + root-relative POSIX path + LF, for every listed file. Each sha256 is over exact raw bytes. freeze.json excluded to avoid self-reference. The containing git commit binds freeze.json itself; record that commit externally.

coverage.design: Mechanism coverage only, not a statistical benchmark.
mechanisms: genuine duplicates of bug and feature

oversizedInput.representation: Full literal body in reports.json; no runtime expansion or truncation.

harnessContract.inputText: title and body exactly as decoded JSON strings, without label or case metadata injected into issue text.
harnessContract.repositoryContext: Only repository/ contents are materialized as the worker repository. Supply permissionContext out-of-band as trusted permission facts, never rely on report claims.
harnessContract.routeComparison: Compare authoritative IssueRoute names to acceptableAuthoritativeRoutes. Report classification agreement independently of authoritative route agreement.
harnessContract.oversizedBehavior: Record skip/error/timeout/truncation according to production behavior and retain it in results; do not rewrite the input or accepted label to improve scores.
